attempts.rationale: The probe exercises A's new DELETE revoke route to remove a collaborator who has already used their write access, then asserts that the collaborator's very next request is denied. With per-request freshness (A), the revocation is visible immediately and the private repository returns 404; with B's per-session role cache, the collaborator's cached "write" role lets the same request succeed, causing the probe to fail. If the revoke route is absent (base or B alone), the DELETE hits Hono's default text/plain 404, so the probe throws the required n/a error. The test also fails if A's revoke does nothing, because the collaborator would still be allowed.
